message.content:
Here’s a curated list of horror movies that will keep you on the edge of your seat this Friday night. I’ve grouped them into three categories—**Classic Chills**, **Modern Thrillers**, and **Psychological Puzzles**—so you can pick whatever vibe you’re after.

---

## Classic Chills  
| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **Psycho** | 1960 | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense; the shower scene is legendary. |
| **The Shining** | 1980 | A haunting psychological descent set in an isolated hotel. |
| **Halloween** | 1978 | The original slasher that introduced Michael Myers. |
| **Night of the Living Dead** | 1968 | George A. Romero’s groundbreaking zombie film. |
| **Rosemary’s Baby** | 1968 | A chilling tale of paranoia and supernatural dread. |

---

## Modern Thrillers  
| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart social thriller with a twisty narrative. |
| **Hereditary** | 2018 | A family drama that turns into a terrifying horror saga. |
| **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence is deadly; the tension never lets up. |
| **It Follows** | 2014 | An eerie curse that follows you wherever you go. |
| **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror that’s as unsettling as it is beautiful. |

---

## Psychological Puzzles  
| Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-------|------|------------------------|
| **The Babadook** | 2014 | A mother’s grief becomes a monstrous reality. |
| **The Others** | 2001 | A haunting house story with a twist ending. |
| **The Sixth Sense** | 1999 | A classic “I see dead people” story with a memorable reveal. |
| **The Witch** | 2015 | A Puritan family’s faith is tested by a sinister presence. |
| **The Ring** | 2002 | A cursed videotape that brings death to those who watch it. |

---

### Quick Picks for a Friday Night Marathon

1. **Psycho** – Start with a classic to set the tone.  
2. **Hereditary** – Keep the intensity high with a modern psychological horror.  
3. **The Others** – End the night with a chilling twist that will linger.

Enjoy the scares, and remember: keep the lights off and the popcorn ready!
